articles.title: Major Train Mishap Averted in Hardoi: Rajdhani and Kathgodam Express Saved by Loco Pilots’ Alertness
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major tragedy was narrowly avoided in Hardoi, Uttar Pradesh, as a conspiracy to derail two trains — Rajdhani Express (20504) and Kathgodam Express (15044) — was foiled due to the swift action of alert loco pilots.

body.html:
A major tragedy was narrowly avoided in Hardoi, Uttar Pradesh, as a conspiracy to derail two trains — Rajdhani Express (20504) and Kathgodam Express (15044) — was foiled due to the swift action of alert loco pilots.

Miscreants had planted earthing wires and wooden blocks on the down track near km 1129/14 between Dalelnagar and Umratali stations, in an attempt to derail the trains. However, Rajdhani Express was stopped using the emergency brake, while Kathgodam Express was saved due to timely action by the crew.

Following the incident, teams from GRP, RPF, and local police rushed to the spot and have launched a full investigation into the sabotage attempt.

body.html:
In a shocking incident from Bansgaon, Gorakhpur (U.P.), a truck driver was brutally beaten by police personnel during a checking operation. The entire incident was captured on CCTV.

According to officials, the truck allegedly rammed a barricade and tried to flee. It was stopped at the next checkpoint, and the driver was pulled out and beaten with sticks. He was later sent to jail by the SDM, and the truck was seized for lacking valid documents.

🔍 Police Statement:
